findings.title: A path containing an embedded newline where one internal line is literally EOF breaks the heredoc: the first line becomes the path, EOF ends the heredoc early, and the rest is parsed as separate shell commands.
findings.evidence: Tried `weird\nEOF\nrest.md` with the exact extracted command: observed FileNotFoundError + `bash: rest.md: command not found`.
findings.consequence: The reviewer judged it does not matter for this use case, since the path is built from a reserved code and a slug, "neither of which can contain a newline by construction" — recorded as a minor/non-blocking observation.
